title: Desk update v0: the channel index
description: desk/channels/<channel>/index.json on the release origin (Cloudflare R2, ADR 0054): the builds on one channel, newest first, signed by the updater key in index.json.sig. A desk reads only this file to choose its next build; release.json then gives the artifact. Unknown fields are allowed, so an installed desk keeps reading what a newer release script writes.

ReleaseChannel.description: A channel is an index, not a version string: stable lists tagged releases, beta canary builds promoted after three days, canary every build of main.

ReleaseVersion.description: A SemVer version without a leading v or build metadata, so its order is SemVer precedence alone: 0.2.0, 0.2.1-pre.48. Every build has its own.

ReleaseTarget.description: A Tauri updater target: {os}-{arch}, or {os}-{arch}-{bundle} when the bundle matters (darwin-aarch64, windows-x86_64-nsis, linux-x86_64-deb). A desk looks for the most specific one it runs as first.

ReleaseCommit.description: The git commit the build was made from, abbreviated or whole.

ReleaseTime.description: An RFC 3339 time with an offset: 2026-11-20T09:12:00Z.

ReleaseIndex.description: The builds on one channel. Taking a build down (rollback) removes its listing; a desk then drops it if it had it staged.

channel.description: The channel this index is for. A desk refuses an index served for another channel.

serial.description: Raised on every write. A desk refuses an index whose serial is below one it has seen for the channel, so a stale copy cannot bring back a build that was taken down.

generated.description: When the release scripts wrote it.

ReleaseListing.description: One build on a channel: what a desk needs to decide whether it is next.

date.description: When the build was published; canary pruning and beta promotion count from it.

minFrom.description: The lowest version that may move to this build directly. A lower desk first takes the newest build whose minFrom it meets (a stepping stone), then this one at its next check.

rollout.description: The share of desks that see the build, 0 to 100; 100 when absent. A desk is in when its bucket for the version is below it.

targets.description: The targets the build has updater artifacts for.

release.description: Its release.json: absolute, or relative to the origin's desk/ folder (releases/0.2.0/release.json).
